title: Reckoner wordmark (v2)
description: A plain two-line wordmark: an icon, the name set large and tight in the display face, and a tiny widely tracked capitals line under it. Takes the current text colour; the icon can be tinted on its own.
notes: a stand-in for a real logo: pass any lucide icon (or none)
name: reckoner-v2-wordmark

props.name: tagline
props.description: the small tracked line under the name (e.g. "credit partners")

props.name: icon
props.description: an icon before the name (a lucide icon)

props.name: iconClassName
props.description: classes for the icon only, e.g. a colour
